rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose word for the newspaper publication, and sometimes by metonymy for the organization behind it.

example.english: I read the newspaper every day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 tai2 bou3 zi2

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean the newspaper office or organization rather than the publication itself.

example.english: They worked at the newspaper office for many years.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 bou3 gun2 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4
